examples.english: In autumn, the leaves turn red.

notes:
{赤|あか} is one of the basic Japanese color words. Can function as a noun, no-adjective, or the base of the i-adjective ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧.

FORMS:
- Noun: {赤|あか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧ (I like red)
- No-adjective: {赤|あか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧ (complete stranger)
- I-adjective: ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (red flower)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧: baby
- ⟦{赤|あか}ワイン→赤ワイン：18930_akawain⟧: red wine
- ⟦{真|ま}っ{赤|か}→真っ赤：03734_makka⟧: bright red; blatant (lie)
- {赤|あか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧: complete stranger
- ⟦{赤字|あかじ}→赤字：04712_akaji⟧: deficit, in the red
